description: Load existing user periods with sheet status and preselect the server-resolved current period.
Show localized date ranges and status, with locked selections explained and Continue disabled.
Resolve or create only the selected sheet on Continue and recheck its actual editability.
Prevent repeated Continue and ignore pending responses after cancellation; retain picker on resolution errors.
Allow explicit historical selection without a current period; show actionable feedback for an empty catalog.
Initialize dates and time defaults inside the selected period using the subject timezone, preserving valid context defaults.
Pass the selected sheet and its actual period together to the bounded entry form while preserving work-item context.
Resolve existing entries through their saved sheet and actual period without offering a period transfer.
Reject saves on locked target or original sheets in the write transaction while retaining existing permission and period guards.
Propagate save failures so the dialog retains entered values; close and refresh the caller once on success.
Provide accessible period selection, theme-aware presentation, and translated labels on shared launcher surfaces.
Keep period selection separate from entry editing and show selected-period context in the editor.
